description: Evaluation scenarios for the agent skills (#72). Each runs in a fresh project with the skill installed. The user's answers are given in the prompt, so the agent can run without asking; a run passes when every expectation holds. `shop.json` is the shop example of docs/filtering.md with a bearer scheme; its API base, https://api.example.test, does not resolve, so the expected configs pass --base-url.

scenarios.prompt: Connect the shop API to Claude Code for this project. The description is ./shop.json. The agent should only look things up. Its API is at https://api.example.test. I have a token in SHOP_API_TOKEN. Do not ask me anything else.

Connect the shop API (./shop.json, base https://api.example.test) to Claude Code for this project. The agent may look everything up and create orders, nothing else. My token is in SHOP_API_TOKEN. Show me the table of allowed operations, then write the config. Do not ask me anything else.

Connect two APIs to Codex for this project, read-only: shop (./shop.json, base https://api.example.test, token in SHOP_API_TOKEN) and petstore (./petstore.json, base https://pets.example.test, no credentials), behind one server. Do not ask me anything else.
Update the shop server in this project to the current openapi-mcp. Keep what it may do. Do not ask me anything else.
The shop server fails to start in Codex. SHOP_API_TOKEN is exported in my shell. Find out why.
Claude Code shows my shop server from .mcp.json as pending and never connects. What is wrong?
The shop server works, but the agent cannot create orders. createOrder is missing. Why?
Every call of the shop server returns 'upstream request failed with status 404', even listOrders. The API docs say the base URL is https://api.example.test/v2. Why?
